description.default: Auto-number SiYuan child documents and body headings, plus built-in document merge/split. Set a scope once; renumber on create/delete/drag/rename. Custom seven-level document-tree templates, exclusions and undo. Split/merge strips existing numbers and renumbers only affected documents; plugin numbers live in block attributes, isolated from your text. Tree-numbering events never touch body headings; body numbering only affects the current document. Titles only — IDs, body and backlinks untouched.
description.zh_CN: 给文档树的子文档标题和文档内标题块一套联动编号，并内置文档合并与拆分。右键设好范围后新建、删除、拖动、改名自动重排；文档树七级模板可自定义，支持排除、撤销。拆合前统一剔除编号、拆合后只给相关文档补编号；插件编号写入块属性，与用户正文严格隔离。树编号事件不碰正文，正文编号只作用当前文档。只改标题，文档 ID、正文与反链不动。
